# Current permission catalog

<!-- Generated by scripts/docs/permission-catalog.go; do not edit manually. -->

This is a source-derived capability catalog, not a list of role assignments or a
runtime authority snapshot. A row never grants access. Built-in/custom role policies,
live grants, delegation ceilings, membership, account/credential state, resource
relationships, and operation-specific checks still determine an actual decision.
Do not infer a built-in role's permissions from its name or from this table.
Worker/notifier database privileges and public authentication ceremonies are not
principal-grantable HTTP permission keys and are outside this catalog.

## Sources and reproduction

- [Canonical OpenAPI](../packages/contracts/openapi/openapi.yaml):
  `PlatformPermission.enum`, `TenantPermissionKey.enum`, `TenantAuthorizationScope.enum`,
  `TenantPrincipalType.enum`, `TenantPermission` principal-type conditions,
  `ServiceAccountCredentialPermissionKey.const`, and `ServiceAccountCredentialScope.const`.
- [Evaluator](../services/api/internal/authorization/evaluator.go):
  `knownPermissions`, `initialTenantPermissions`, and each referenced
  `tenantPermissionMetadata.scopes` / `.principalKinds` declaration.
- [Go symbols](../services/api/internal/authorization/model.go): exact scope, principal,
  and tenant-permission literals. The generator reads Go syntax, not role names.

The generator consumes the generated OpenAPI JSON bundle; run the existing drift
gate first to prove that bundle matches canonical YAML. It rejects mismatched key
sets, unknown metadata forms, principal-type drift, and machine-credential tuple drift.
No database, secrets, network, or application service is needed. From the repository root:

```bash
corepack pnpm verify:generated
go run scripts/docs/permission-catalog.go --write
go run scripts/docs/permission-catalog.go --check
go test scripts/docs/permission-catalog.go scripts/docs/permission-catalog_test.go
```

`--check` (also the default) checks committed documentation without writing. Generation
contains no timestamp or environment-specific data. See the [authorization model](permissions.md)
for scope/delegation semantics and the historical rollout tables.

## Platform capabilities (25)

These exact keys belong to `Session.permissions` (human-session platform authority),
not tenant role-policy tuples. The machine credential allowlist contains no platform
key. `platform` below describes the authority domain, not an inferred role grant.

## Tenant capabilities (85)

Scopes are exact catalog-admitted tuples, not automatic delegation rights. `human`
includes customer-portal users where their live policy and resource relationship
permit it; it does not mean every human or operator may use the capability.
`service_account` means the evaluator admits that principal kind, still constrained
by live machine authority and the exact credential allowlist.
